scope: Read-only source, protocol and direct runtime probes; no build or network actions.

probes.name: Complete cross-field aggregate winner precedes stronger per-field-only candidates
Only selected fields qualify candidates; short invalid/disabled fields reject
Empty, short and punctuation-only requests return no dictionary visits
NFKC original token is normalized once and astral minimum uses code points
Zero output capacity retains full total; candidate overflow rejects even with limit zero
Output cap includes object keys, array length, slots and item keys
Query lexical capacity does not inherit record-value length ceiling
Generic dictionary reader refuses a field outside manifest requirements
Aliases of one trusted dictionary registration share one work cap
